East Zone's bowlers effectively maintained pressure throughout the match's initial session.

title: Odisha govt to transfer alimony from salaries of defaulting staffers to ex-wives
content: Odisha government will now deduct alimony directly from employee salaries. This order ensures timely financial support for estranged wives and children. Repeated complaints prompted the chief minister to take this stern stance. Court orders will now be enforced through automated salary deductions. This initiative aims to uphold judicial authority and ease family distress.

title: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna disagrees with Jamie Dimon on this meeting habit
content: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon considers device use in meetings disrespectful. IBM CEO Arvind Krishna differentiates between small and large meeting device policies. He believes large gatherings are primarily for information sharing, not discussion. Krishna expects full attention during smaller, face-to-face meetings with fewer attendees. Dimon advocates for complete focus, calling device checking a waste of valuable time.

title: PM Modi conferred with Uzbekistan’s highest state honour
content: During his two-day visit to Uzbekistan, Prime Minister Narendra Modi was awarded the prestigious Order of Oliy Darajali Dustlik, the highest state honor from Uzbekistan. Presented by President Shavkat Mirziyoyev, this award highlighted Modi's role in enhancing the strategic partnership between India and Uzbekistan. The leaders engaged in discussions aimed at boosting bilateral cooperation and aligning their developmental goals.

title: 7 bodies swept into Gandak river in Maharajganj, Kushinagar amid Nepal floods
content: Seven unidentified bodies have been recovered from the Gandak river in Uttar Pradesh. Devastating floods in Nepal caused a sharp rise in the river's water flow. Officials are working to identify the deceased individuals found in the water. Bodies were discovered in Maharajganj and Kushinagar districts by villagers and SSB personnel. Efforts are ongoing to manage the situation and identify the recovered victims.

title: Imran Khan’s journey from World Cup hero to Pakistan PM and prisoner: Full story
content: Concerns about Imran Khan's health have been highlighted by his sons, who allege intentional isolation and threats to their father's well-being. Appeals for compassionate treatment and access to adequate medical care have emerged from former cricketers. Since his 2022 dismissal from the prime ministership, Khan has encountered several legal troubles and convictions related to his political fallout.

title: 'Bill Gates wrong about robot tax': Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang disagrees with Bill Gates' robot tax proposal. Huang believes AI will create more jobs overall, not fewer. He suggests companies with increased productivity tend to hire more people. Huang sees a future of reindustrialization with demand for skilled labor. This new economic era will create many jobs across various sectors.

title: After 155 years in private hands, Nevada divorce ranch becomes a state park
content: Transforming from a historic divorce haven into a state park, Nevada's Lower Carson Ranch now spans 1,627 acres alongside the Carson River, preserving crucial wildlife habitats. This transition marks the end of 155 years of private ownership, officially now under Nevada State Parks. While development for future public use is underway and access is limited, the community is actively participating in selecting a new name for the park.

title: Superconductors finally prove quantum imaging effect predicted two decades ago
content: The University of Illinois Chicago’s Dirk Morr proposed a way to create high-resolution quantum images using superconductors two decades ago. A new experiment by researchers in Germany, supported by Morr’s theoretical model, has now produced quantum imaging similar to what he predicted, providing experimental confirmation of his earlier work.

title: Kevin O’Leary’s blunt advice to startup founders: Cut losses on failing businesses
content: Kevin O'Leary emphasizes the importance of startup founders acknowledging early failures in their business journey. He notes that pouring more funds into inherently flawed ideas does not lead to success. Instead, founders should accept their losses, gather insights from these experiences, and pivot towards new opportunities. With around eighty percent of startups facing failure, it's crucial for entrepreneurs to not be weighed down by each setback.

title: Iran war at 6 months: Who gained, who lost the most economically
content: Six months into the war, global economic fears have not fully materialized.  Oil prices surged initially but have since eased from their peak.  Financial markets have recovered strongly, boosted by artificial intelligence optimism.  Airlines and farmers face increased costs, impacting travelers and food security.  Clean energy and defense contractors have emerged as significant beneficiaries.

title: India reaches fiscal deficit target for 2025-26, credit ratings improving: FM Sitharaman
content: India proudly announces the achievement of its fiscal deficit target for 2025-26, showcasing commendable fiscal discipline. With a clear vision, the government aspires to maintain a 50 percent debt-to-GDP ratio by 2030. This fiscal prudence was executed without compromising social welfare or infrastructure investment. Notably, smart arrangements and subsidies enabled the smooth supply of fertilisers. Meanwhile, India navigates the complex landscape of bilateral trade agreements, as multilateral efforts progress slowly.

title: SUV kills 2 brothers, injures 2 sisters on way to celebrate Rakhi in Faridabad
content: Two brothers died and their sisters were injured by a speeding Toyota Fortuner. The vehicle struck them while they waited for a bus on Gurgaon-Faridabad Road. Doctors declared the brothers dead at BK Civil Hospital in Faridabad. Their injured sisters were referred to AIIMS Trauma Centre in Delhi. Police are using the recovered number plate to trace the fleeing driver.

title: How to avoid rental disputes: Delhi Police plans awareness session for Northeast tenants
content: Delhi Police will host an awareness program next week for Northeast residents.  The event will focus on rental agreements and security deposit issues.  Tenants will learn about their rights and responsibilities regarding rent.  Police will widely circulate advisories with community leaders' help.  This initiative aims to prevent and resolve landlord-tenant disputes effectively.

title: Why 15-yo Sooryavanshi took charge as stand-in captain in Duleep semifinal
content: Teenage sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi took charge as East Zone’s stand-in captain during their Duleep Trophy semifinal against Central Zone after Ishan Kishan suffered a thumb injury. Sooryavanshi, usually the vice-captain, embraced the responsibility after impressing with the ball in the quarter-final. East Zone also made a strong start, reducing Central Zone to 81/3.

title: Jharkhand jail inmates can work outside, return by evening
content: Jharkhand prisoners will soon work outside jail during the day. Selected inmates will earn a livelihood and return to prison in the evening. This initiative will be introduced through open and semi-open barracks at four central jails. The move aims to strengthen correctional reforms and aid prisoner reintegration into society. Eligibility criteria will focus on good conduct and adherence to prison rules.

title: The Battle of Haji Pir: Inside the most iconic battle of the 1965 war
content: Pakistan launched Operation Gibraltar in 1965, sending infiltrators into Jammu and Kashmir. Indian forces then launched Operation Bakshi to capture the Haji Pir Pass. Major Ranjit Singh Dayal led a successful assault, securing the strategic mountain pass. Pakistani forces launched counter-attacks but failed to retake the captured position. The pass was later returned to Pakistan under the Tashkent Agreement.

title: Watch: CM Yogi in splits after Ravi Kishan compares Gorakhpur to Spain
content: BJP MP Ravi Kishan praised Gorakhpur's development, comparing it to Spain. He spoke at the inauguration of a newly constructed Kalyan Mandapam in Basharatpur. Kishan stated the city felt like a smart city due to visible progress. He expressed pride in the changes witnessed across the area. His remarks prompted laughter and smiles from attendees and officials.

title: Toxic box office day 5: Yash's film eyes Rs 200 crore mark
content: Yash's film 'Toxic' has achieved significant box office success in its opening days. The movie has already garnered over Rs 255 crore in worldwide gross collections. Its India net collection is rapidly approaching the Rs 200 crore milestone. The film collected Rs 101.10 crore net on its opening day. Subsequent days showed steady collections, contributing to its overall performance.

title: 'Pakistan chapter I had before is now closed': Amir calls himself 'British local'
content: Mohammad Amir has ruled out a return to Pakistan’s national team after obtaining British citizenship and a British passport. The former Pakistan pacer said his “Pakistan chapter” is now closed because he is now a British local. Amir retired internationally in 2024 after a career highlighted by major performances in ICC tournaments.

title: Influencer who died after being ‘tied to tree, burnt alive’ was 7 weeks pregnant
content: A social media influencer died after suffering severe burn injuries.  She was allegedly abducted and set on fire near Morinda.  Police are searching for two suspects identified in the FIR.  Questions have arisen regarding a potential delay in recording her statement.  An investigation into the circumstances of her death is ongoing.

title: Russia prepares for ‘massive strikes’ against Ukraine's energy facilities
content: Amid rising tensions, Russia announced plans for large-scale attacks aimed at Ukraine's energy infrastructure, following strikes on its own civilian areas. A recent attack in Bucha tragically resulted in thirty-seven fatalities. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy called out perceived negligence in ammunition storage practices. As these aerial campaigns escalate, the region faces a deepening crisis with infrastructure under relentless assault.

title: Nepal-Tibet floods: 750 dead, 20,000 deployed as rising rivers hamper rescue ops
content: Nepal and Tibet floods have claimed 750 lives and left over 3,000 missing.  Rescuers continue operations amid warnings of fresh flooding and difficult conditions.  Hundreds are believed trapped in hydropower tunnels, requiring specialized international assistance.  India and China are providing crucial support including forensic experts and relief supplies.  Infrastructure damage has cut off communities, while aid efforts are ongoing.

title: DDA launches Delhi’s MPD-2047: From property rules to development norms, 10 key FAQs
content: The Delhi Development Authority has unveiled a set of FAQs regarding the Master Plan Delhi 2047, effective from August 20, 2026, and replacing the prior version. This comprehensive plan outlines regulations pertaining to land use, construction, and redevelopment in distinct areas. Additionally, it provides insights on land pooling and transit-oriented development strategies. An online portal is available for citizens to give their feedback.

title: ‘Please, let’s not’: Gavaskar rejects free-hit idea in Test cricket
content: Sunil Gavaskar stands firm against the introduction of free hits for no-balls in Test cricket, arguing that this practice offers batters unearned advantages. Instead, he suggests implementing financial penalties that escalate with repeated infractions, potentially involving the bowler’s coach. Furthermore, Gavaskar proposes that teams should have the authority to vote on additional penalties for on-field errors, encouraging a culture of accountability.

title: PM Modi in Tashkent: India, Uzbekistan agree to strengthen trade, defence and energy ties

Modi's participation in a yoga session underscored their cultural bonds, ahead of his journey to Kyrgyzstan for the upcoming SCO summit.

title: ‘Uzbekistan loves yoga’: PM Modi joins special session during Tashkent, shares video

title: NEET-PG 2026 exam at Jaipur centre rescheduled to September 5 over power outage
content: The NEET-PG 2026 examination at a Jaipur centre was rescheduled for September 5. This decision followed power outages and technical disruptions during the test on Sunday. Nearly 300 candidates were affected by the rescheduling at the Sitapura centre. Aspirants reported repeated computer shutdowns and system failures during the examination. Officials are investigating the technical arrangements and their impact on the exam's fairness.

title: 4 days under debris, still alive: How a 97-year-old woman survived Nepal floods
content: In an inspiring tale of survival, a 97-year-old woman managed to endure four harrowing days trapped in rubble after the catastrophic flash floods in Nepal. Rescue teams are still combing through the obliterated regions for additional survivors. Although some individuals fled to safety, many families are left mourning their missing members and the devastation of their homes, revealing a bittersweet mix of hope and tragedy in this dire situation.

The 20-time Grand Slam champion thanked those who supported his journey and encouraged future players to keep advancing tennis. Mary Carillo was also inducted, calling the honour beyond her dreams.

title: ‘Identify your real enemy’: Khamenei urges Gulf rulers to unite, defend each other

The message comes amid ongoing war and significant economic pressure on Iran. Iranian President dismissed speculation about the leader's health, stating he is healthy. Diplomacy and defense remain Iran's complementary approach to national interests.

title: Russia turns to India for petrol as Ukraine attacks disrupt fuel supplies

In August, Russian gasoline imports hit unprecedented levels, with India emerging as a central contributor. Much of this gasoline was transported using sanctioned ships and involved intricate transfer practices. Increased crude oil imports from Russia by India are likely driving this expanded gasoline export relationship.
